briefing.headline: PSG Wealth leads wealth share of voice this week
points: 273 news mentions across 14 wealth brands in the past 7 days, down 1% on the week before.
PSG Wealth leads share of voice with 12.8%, followed by Momentum (12.5%) and Allan Gray (9.5%).
Biggest riser: Brenthurst, up 12 mentions week on week. Biggest faller: Investec, down 15.
Most common activity this week: CSR & community (29 items).
23 reputation or regulatory items this week, involving Alexander Forbes, Allan Gray, Citadel, Liberty, Momentum, Ninety One, Old Mutual, PSG Wealth, Sygnia.
